note: Zoom (repainted, S03 richness) on the cushion-piled window seat under the atelier's back window: sage-green panelling, white trim, limestone floor, the courtyard trees outside. LANDMARK: the long window seat heaped with silk cushions. Calm, preference and splendour on the left (feminine, left of x=700); winks, scruples and exotic hats on the right (masculine). The blank board beside the window is the sign; the strip's Back button returns to the atelier.
